names: Squats day — front squat + upper, 9,670 kg

en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 10 – Aug 16 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~631 kcal/day against ~436 last window, and the jump is one day: Saturday's Zagreb hike put 1,586 active kcal on the board. Thursday's gym session added 629, Monday's swim-plus-SUP day 941 and Tuesday 830, Friday was a true rest day at 79, and today reads 1 — nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 690 because the day is incomplete). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −1,045 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Saturday alone implies ≈ −2,000. Sunday (Aug 16) has barely started.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: The hike rewrote the week — 8h 30m, nearly double last window
en.i1: 7 sessions across 5 active days, 8h 30m and ~4,414 active kcal — against 7 sessions, 4h 18m and ~3,054 kcal in the Aug 9 – Aug 15 window. Same session count, roughly twice the time, because Sunday the 9th's 15-minute SUP rolled off the back and Saturday's Zagreb hike rolled on: 4h 27m, 16.5 km, 573 m of climbing, 23,294 steps, avg HR 109 with a max of 154. That single day is 52% of the window's moving time and 36% of its active calories. Water work is now closed out at two open-water swims totalling 2,286 m and three SUP paddles totalling 6,541 m, all of it Monday through Wednesday in Primošten. Friday was a clean rest day — 79 active kcal, max HR 110 — and today is empty so far at 1 kcal.
en.i2t: Still one lift on the board: 9,670 kg, and it is now three days back
en.i2: Thursday 16:40 to 17:45 — 67 minutes, 603 kcal, avg 118 bpm and a max of 156, still the highest heart rate of the window ahead of Monday's 154 and Saturday's 154. Sixteen sets, 165 reps, 9,670 kg across five exercises. Front squat led at 60×6, then 80×10, 80×6, 80×6 — a deliberately conservative top load for a first day back after fourteen days off. Lat pulldown ran 65, 65, 70 kg for 12s, chest press 65, 70, 70 with reps slipping 12/12/10, leg curl climbed 40/45/50, and the closing shoulder press faded hard: 40×12, 40×10, then 35×6. Three days on, nothing has been added. The lift-HR chart is still frozen because front squat is not one of the three tracked lifts, so trap-bar, hack squat and goblet squat end at Jun 20, Jul 28 and Jun 11 respectively — the hack squat gap is now nineteen days.
en.i3t: All streams clean — the hike is Garmin-only, as expected
en.i3: Seven consecutive recorded nights with HRV on each and no empty slots on the chart. Hevy and Intervals.icu were both synced before this refresh and neither returned anything for Aug 14–16, so Thursday's session remains the last logged tonnage and the 9,670 kg figure is still measured rather than estimated. Saturday's hike carries no Hevy entry because it is not a lift — its 1,912 activity kcal come straight off the watch, and note that Garmin's daily active total for that day reads 1,586, the lower of the two, which is what the energy and burn charts use. Garmin ran clean through this morning; last night's sleep landed at 06:18 and today's daily totals are still near zero.
en.i4t: Recovery: best night of the week, RHR the only holdout
en.i4: Last night ran 7h 21m for a score of 84 — up 8 from 76, 1h 20m longer, and 29 minutes over the 6h 52m average. It ties Sunday for the best score of the window. Lights out at 22:36 was the earliest of the week bar one minute, two hours ahead of Thursday's 00:44. The stages skewed light: deep only 65 minutes (15% of the night, second-lowest after Monday's 61), REM up strongly to 89 from 62, light at 287, and awake time back up to 21 minutes so efficiency slipped to 96% from Friday's 98%. That is the normal shape after a long aerobic day rather than a hard one. HRV rose a second straight night to 39, two over the 37 average and the highest since Monday's 42. Morning stress is 20, the lowest of the window. Readiness 78. RHR is the laggard at 55 for the third straight morning, still top of its 53–55 band — the expected lag behind a 4h 27m hike.
en.rec: Yesterday's plan called for a strength session with a tracked lift; you hiked 16.5 km instead. That is a fair trade for a Saturday and the sleep response backs it — 7h 21m, score 84, HRV up a second night — but it means the gym has now gone three days without tonnage and nineteen days without a hack squat. Today is not the day to fix that with a heavy session: 573 m of descent yesterday means the quads have taken an eccentric beating you will feel more today than you did last night, and RHR at 55 is still sitting at the top of its band. Do a short, technical strength day this afternoon — hack squat is the lift to open, but at 130–150 kg for four or five controlled working sets, not the 185 kg from Jul 28. The point today is to put a clean reading back on the per-set HR chart, not to add load; the series has been blind for weeks and one honest session ends that. Cap total tonnage around 7,000–8,000 kg and skip anything that loads the legs a second time. Keep the bedtime that produced this: 22:36 worked, and holding it two more nights should finally pull RHR off 55 and back to the 53 it hit on Tuesday and Thursday. Next: light hack-squat session today, easy or off Monday, lights out before 23:00 both nights.

hr.k3d: 2 plivanja na moru · 3 SUP · 1 teretana · 1 planinarenje
hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 10.–16.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosječno ~631 kcal/dan naspram ~436 prethodnog prozora, a cijeli skok je jedan dan: subotnje planinarenje po Zagrebu upisalo je 1.586 aktivnih kcal. Četvrtkova teretana dodala je 629, ponedjeljak (plivanje + SUP) 941, utorak 830, petak je bio pravi dan odmora sa 79, a danas piše 1 — jutros još ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 690 jer dan nije završen). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −1.045 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, ne mjerena. Sama subota implicira ≈ −2.000. Nedjelja (16.8.) tek je počela.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Planinarenje je prepisalo tjedan — 8h 30m, gotovo dvostruko od prošlog prozora
hr.i1: 7 treninga kroz 5 aktivnih dana, 8h 30m i ~4.414 aktivnih kcal — naspram 7 treninga, 4h 18m i ~3.054 kcal u prozoru 9.–15.8. Isti broj treninga, otprilike dvostruko vremena, jer je nedjeljni petnaestominutni SUP od 9. ispao sa stražnjeg kraja, a subotnje planinarenje po Zagrebu ušlo: 4h 27m, 16,5 km, 573 m uspona, 23.294 koraka, prosječni puls 109 uz maksimum od 154. Taj jedan dan čini 52% vremena kretanja u prozoru i 36% aktivnih kalorija. Rad u vodi sada je zaključen na dva plivanja na moru ukupno 2.286 m i tri veslanja na SUP-u ukupno 6.541 m, sve od ponedjeljka do srijede u Primoštenu. Petak je bio čist dan odmora — 79 aktivnih kcal, maksimalni puls 110 — a danas je zasad prazno, 1 kcal.
hr.i2t: I dalje jedan trening snage na ploči: 9.670 kg, a sada je tri dana iza
hr.i2: Četvrtak od 16:40 do 17:45 — 67 minuta, 603 kcal, prosjek 118 otkucaja i maksimum od 156, i dalje najviši puls u prozoru ispred ponedjeljkovih 154 i subotnjih 154. Šesnaest serija, 165 ponavljanja, 9.670 kg kroz pet vježbi. Prednji čučanj je vodio s 60×6, pa 80×10, 80×6, 80×6 — namjerno konzervativna gornja težina za prvi dan povratka nakon četrnaest dana pauze. Povlačenje na lat mašini išlo je 65, 65, 70 kg po 12, potisak za prsa 65, 70, 70 uz pad ponavljanja 12/12/10, pregib potkoljenice rastao je 40/45/50, a zaključni potisak za ramena osjetno je popustio: 40×12, 40×10, pa 35×6. Tri dana kasnije ništa nije dodano. Graf pulsa po serijama i dalje stoji jer prednji čučanj nije jedno od tri praćena podizanja, pa trap-bar, hack čučanj i goblet čučanj završavaju 20.6., 28.7. odnosno 11.6. — pauza u hack čučnju sada je devetnaest dana.
hr.i3t: Svi tokovi čisti — planinarenje je samo na Garminu, kako i treba
hr.i3: Sedam uzastopnih zabilježenih noći, HRV upisan na svakoj, bez praznih mjesta na grafu. Hevy i Intervals.icu sinkronizirani su prije ovog osvježavanja i nijedan nije vratio ništa za 14.–16.8., pa četvrtkov trening ostaje zadnja zabilježena tonaža, a podatak od 9.670 kg i dalje je izmjeren, a ne procijenjen. Subotnje planinarenje nema zapis u Hevyju jer nije trening snage — njegovih 1.912 kcal dolazi izravno sa sata, uz napomenu da Garminov dnevni aktivni zbroj za taj dan pokazuje 1.586, nižu od dvije brojke, i to je ono što koriste grafovi energije i potrošnje. Garmin je radio čisto do jutros; sinoćnji san stigao je u 06:18, a današnji dnevni zbrojevi još su blizu nule.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: najbolja noć tjedna, RHR jedini zaostatak
hr.i4: Sinoć je noć trajala 7h 21m uz ocjenu 84 — osam više od 76, 1h 20m dulje i 29 minuta iznad prosjeka od 6h 52m. Izjednačeno s nedjeljom kao najbolja ocjena u prozoru. Gašenje svjetla u 22:36 bilo je najranije u tjednu uz razliku od jedne minute, dva sata ispred četvrtkovih 00:44. Faze su nagnute prema laganom snu: duboki san samo 65 minuta (15% noći, drugi najniži nakon ponedjeljkove 61), REM snažno gore na 89 s 62, lagani na 287, a budnost natrag na 21 minutu pa je učinkovitost pala na 96% s petkovih 98%. To je normalan oblik nakon dugog aerobnog, a ne teškog dana. HRV je drugu noć zaredom porastao, na 39, dva iznad prosjeka od 37 i najviše od ponedjeljkovih 42. Jutarnji stres je 20, najniže u prozoru. Spremnost 78. RHR zaostaje na 55 treće jutro zaredom, i dalje na vrhu raspona 53–55 — očekivano kašnjenje iza planinarenja od 4h 27m.
hr.rec: Jučerašnji plan tražio je trening snage s praćenim podizanjem; umjesto toga odradio si 16,5 km planinarenja. Za subotu je to poštena zamjena i odgovor sna to potvrđuje — 7h 21m, ocjena 84, HRV gore drugu noć — ali znači da je teretana sada tri dana bez tonaže i devetnaest dana bez hack čučnja. Danas nije dan da se to ispravi teškom sesijom: 573 m spusta jučer znači da su kvadricepsi primili ekscentrični udarac koji ćeš danas osjetiti više nego sinoć, a RHR na 55 još sjedi na vrhu svog raspona. Odradi kratak, tehnički trening snage poslijepodne — hack čučanj je podizanje za otvoriti, ali na 130–150 kg kroz četiri ili pet kontroliranih radnih serija, ne na 185 kg s 28.7. Poanta danas je vratiti čisto očitanje na graf pulsa po serijama, a ne dodavati težinu; niz je tjednima slijep i jedna poštena sesija to zatvara. Ograniči ukupnu tonažu na oko 7.000–8.000 kg i preskoči sve što po drugi put opterećuje noge. Zadrži lijeganje koje je proizvelo ovo: 22:36 je upalilo, a održi li se još dvije noći, RHR bi napokon trebao sići s 55 natrag na 53 koliko je bio u utorak i četvrtak. Sljedeće: lagani hack čučanj danas, lagano ili slobodno u ponedjeljak, gašenje svjetla prije 23:00 obje noći.
